> you removed good templates

Yes I'm convinced most use-case won't specify templates for those widgets so I just wanted to ensure it's easy without.

> Woah you removed good templates, was it easy in the end?

I would say so-so because of CSS rules like `.ais-menu--item__active .facet-value, .facet-value:hover, .ais-refinement-list--item__active .ais-refinement-list--label, .ais-hierarchical-menu--item__active > div > .facet-value {...}` => very hard to "share" behavior because of BEM. We'll need to iterate for v1.0 :) (cc @pixelastic)
